5 – India, a Home to Many 125 Reprint 2026-27 Chapter 5.indd 125 27-11-2025 11:11:59 In the chapter “Unity in Diversity, or ‘Many in the One’ ” (Grade 6 Social Science textbook), we read that “many Indians may be called migrants, in the sense of people not living near their birthplace or with their original community.” In this chapter, we will explore another type of migrants — people who came to India from other parts of the world and settled here, adding another dimension to the diversity.
